headline: Middle East War Escalates with Multi-State Involvement, Directly Disrupting Global Energy and Supply Chains
summary: Recent reports confirm the UAE has struck Iran multiple times with US and Israeli intelligence support, signifying a major escalation of the 'Iran War'. This deepening conflict is already disrupting critical Gulf energy supplies, impacting global crude oil prices, and flattening Chinese factory activity, posing an immediate and significant threat to global economic stability and broader supply chain logistics.
